gateway_ruined_DESC: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
behemoth_egg_DESC: Gigantyczny organiczny statek z dojrzewającym behemotem w środku.
behemoth_egg_ruined_DESC: Po narodzinach behemota zostały tylko szczątki.
behemoth_big_egg_ruined_DESC: Po narodzinach behemota zostały tylko szczątki.

behemoth_chrysalis_big_DESC: Gigantyczny organiczny statek z dojrzewającym behemotem w środku.
behemoth_fleet_egg_DESC: Olbrzymia struktura organiczna, którą złożył Behemot IV klasy.
behemoth_fast_egg_hatch_DESC:
Rozpocznij narodziny małej floty () okrętów biologicznych.
O tym, jakie jednostki się wyklują, decyduje nasza Rozwój jaja polityka.
behemoth_slow_egg_hatch_DESC:
Rozpocznij narodziny dużej floty () okrętów biologicznych.
O tym, jakie jednostki się wyklują, decyduje nasza Rozwój jaja polityka.
lgate_base_DESC: Punkt końcowy ukrytej sieci szlaków podprzestrzennych, niedostępnych inną drogą ze zwykłej przestrzeni.
mega_shipyard_0_DESC: Stacja będąca placem budowy i służąca jako platforma, na której w przyszłości ma powstać Superstocznia.
mega_shipyard_1_DESC: Początkowy szkielet, z którego powstanie Superstocznia, najbardziej wydajne miejsce budowy statków kosmicznych w całej galaktyce.
mega_shipyard_2_DESC: Rdzeń zawiera mnóstwo infrastruktury, której potrzebuje Superstocznia, by transportować i przetwarzać ogromne ilości materiałów do zaopatrywania doków produkcyjnych.
mega_shipyard_3_DESC: Dzięki wielu dokom do budowy statków kosmicznych, zaopatrywanym przez hiperwydajny rdzeń przetwórczy, superstocznia zaćmiewa wydajnością wszystkie inne bazy gwiezdne.
mega_shipyard_ruined_DESC: Ta Superstocznia nie będzie budować żadnych statków kosmicznych - wymaga remontu kapitalnego.
grand_archive_0_DESC: Specjalna budowla orbitalna przeznaczona do przechowywania i prezentacji ciekawych ['concept_specimen', okazów], które zebraliśmy z całej galaktyki. Jest wśród nich fauna kosmiczna.
crisis_sphere_0_DESC: Konstrukcja otaczająca gwiazdę jest podstawą przyszłego silnika eterofazowego. Rozbuduj tę superkonstrukcję do końca, a wygrasz grę.
crisis_sphere_1_DESC: Silnik eterofazowy, który zniszczy bariery istniejące między tym światem i Woalem, jest częściowo gotowy. Rozbuduj tę superkonstrukcję do końca, a wygrasz grę.
crisis_sphere_2_DESC: Silnik eterofazowy, który zniszczy bariery istniejące między tym światem i Woalem, jest częściowo gotowy. Rozbuduj tę superkonstrukcję do końca, a wygrasz grę.
crisis_sphere_3_DESC: Silnik eterofazowy, który zniszczy bariery istniejące między tym światem i Woalem, jest częściowo gotowy. Rozbuduj tę superkonstrukcję do końca, a wygrasz grę.
hyper_relay_DESC: Pojedynczy hiperprzekaźnik jest bezużyteczny, ale ich łańcuch umożliwia szybkie podróżowanie między sąsiednimi układami.
hyper_relay_ruined_DESC: Ta zniszczona konstrukcja była kiedyś częścią łańcucha hiperprzekaźników umożliwiających szybkie podróżowanie.
hyper_relay_restored_DESC: Pojedynczy hiperprzekaźnik jest bezużyteczny, ale ich łańcuch umożliwia szybkie podróżowanie między sąsiednimi układami.
dyson_sphere_0_DESC: Stacja miejsca budowy służy jako baza dla mającej powstać sfery Dysona.
dyson_sphere_ruined_DESC: The ruined shell of a massive station, created by an ancient species. It has long been looted of anything valuable.
STH_bio_habitat_0_DESC: Growing a Habitat lets us expand our influence and provides housing for our people.
STH_borg_catapult_0_DESC: Assimilation of various technologies have allowed the collective to refine their transwarp hubs into a working catapult capable of moving drones across the galaxy at pace.
STH_borg_catapult_1_DESC: Increased power modulation has created a more stable Transwarp Aperture for more efficent travel.
STH_borg_catapult_2_DESC: Increased power modulation and transwarp calculations has created a more stable Transwarp Aperture for more efficent travel.
STH_borg_catapult_3_DESC: Further infusion of nanites have allowed the creation of a Aperture Hub allowing incursions by drones across the galaxy.
STH_borg_recycle_01_DESC: Borg Space units are broken down to their construal parts for redistribution within the collective.
STH_borg_recycle_02_DESC: Borg Space units are broken down to their construal parts for redistribution within the collective at greater efficiency.
STH_cardassian_recycle_01_DESC: A facility dedicated to recycling and reclaiming materials from decommissioned Starships.
STH_cardassian_recycle_02_DESC: A fully upgrade facility dedicated to recycling and reclaiming materials from decommissioned Starships.
STH_dom_science_station_DESC: The Science Station is the centre of our scientific research and R&D, where the best and brightest scientific minds work on exciting new projects all for the greater good of the Founders.
STH_dominion_recycle_01_DESC: A facility dedicated to recycling and reclaiming materials from decommissioned Starships.
STH_dominion_recycle_02_DESC: A fully upgrade facility dedicated to recycling and reclaiming materials from decommissioned Starships.
STH_fed_jupiter_station_DESC: The Science Station is the centre of scientific research and R&D for Starfleet, where the best and brightest scientific minds work on exciting new projects.
STH_federation_recycle_01_DESC: A facility dedicated to recycling and reclaiming materials from decommissioned Starships.
STH_federation_recycle_02_DESC: A fully upgrade facility dedicated to recycling and reclaiming materials from decommissioned Starships.
STH_generic_recycle_01_DESC: A facility dedicated to recycling and reclaiming materials from decommissioned Starships.
STH_generic_recycle_02_DESC: A fully upgrade facility dedicated to recycling and reclaiming materials from decommissioned Starships.
STH_generic_science_station_DESC: The Science Station is the centre of our scientific research and R&D, where the best and brightest scientific minds work on exciting new projects.
STH_grand_archive_DESC: A dedicated orbital structure designed to house and display noteworthy objects and specimens we have collected throughout the galaxy.
STH_great_link_0_DESC: The Great Link is a unique and complex biome composed of a countless number of our gods, intertwined. When needed, in times of great effort and secrecy, we can relocate them to create the Link anywhere, on a different planet. Our new home will never be the same.
STH_helix_0_DESC: Helixes are space habitats capable of housing a number of Pops and Buildings. Expansion is achieved through the attachment of additional cell units.
STH_hunters_lodge_0_DESC: Hunter's Lodges serve as way stations for Hirogen between hunts.
STH_kdf_great_house: The Great Houses of the Klingon Empire
STH_kdf_great_house_DESC: The Klingon Empire is made up of many great and noble houses, each has their own private military institutes where in they can replenish their military might and conviene to celebrate their victories.
STH_kdf_imperial_shipyards_DESC: The Imperial HQ and Shipyards have served as the Empire's main shipbuilding function for the United Empire and have constructed many of the KDF's most memorable warships.
STH_kdf_science_station_DESC: The Science Lab is the centre of scientific research and R&D for the Klingon Defence Force, where new projects are developed to aid the Klingon war efforts.
STH_klingon_recycle_01_DESC: A facility dedicated to recycling and reclaiming materials from decommissioned Starships.
STH_klingon_recycle_02_DESC: A fully upgrade facility dedicated to recycling and reclaiming materials from decommissioned Starships.
STH_klingon_war_museum_0_DESC: The Klingon War Museum stores the designs of vessels from stories of old, where ancient warriors sought out battle.
STH_mega_shipyard_DESC: A shipyard is a type of facility where starships can be built, repaired, or refitted.
STH_orbital_battery_1_DESC: An orbital defense grid designed to provide additional defensive for a planet or system.
STH_orbital_battery_upgrade_DESC: Upgrade the Orbital Defense grid to the latest design in the ship designer.
STH_praetorian_naval_museum_0_DESC: The Praetorian Naval Museum stores the designs of vessels from stories of old, where proud Romulans forged the Star Empire.
STH_relocate_ds9_DESC: Deploy a Deep Space Station at the mouth of the Wormhole to lay claim to it.
STH_research_starbase_1_DESC: Builds a dedicated Scientific Starbase in orbit of this planetary body to conduct and produce research.
STH_research_starbase_upgrade_DESC: Upgrades a dedicated Scientific Starbase in orbit of this planetary body to conduct and produce research.
STH_rom_praetorian_shipyards_DESC: A major historical Romulan ship building facility, that was responsible for the work done helping the Empire break the warp 7 barrier.
STH_rom_science_station_DESC: The Science Lab is the centre of scientific research and R&D for the Romulan Imperial Navy, where new projects are developed to aid the Romulan strategy.
STH_romulan_recycle_01_DESC: A facility dedicated to recycling and reclaiming materials from decommissioned Starships.
STH_romulan_recycle_02_DESC: A fully upgrade facility dedicated to recycling and reclaiming materials from decommissioned Starships.
STH_starfleet_naval_museum_0_DESC:
The Starfleet Naval Museum is operated by the civilian 'Starfleet Historical Society' on behalf of Starfleet.

It houses a number of retired starships, preserving the ships of the past for future generations.
STH_starfleet_utopia_planitia_DESC: A key Starfleet vessel construction and design facility. The facility included several large drafting rooms for starship design and planetary facilities on the surface of Mars.
STH_subcomplex_0_DESC: Subcomplexes are permanent support facilities, consisting of analysis nodes, construction facilities, and coordination hubs.
STH_subcomplex_base_DESC: Biosynthetic cores are gargantuan assimilated lifeforms engineered by the Borg to act as self-growing platforms upon which subcomplexes can be constructed. The technology was derived from analysis of living, reef-like macrostructures discovered in Fluidic Space.
STH_terok_nor_DESC: Terok Nor is a space station of Cardassian design. The station is used for the processing of ore by Bajoran laborers.
STH_undine_recycle_01_DESC: Bio Units are broken down and returned to the Undine.
STH_undine_recycle_02_DESC: Bio Units are broken down and returned to the Undine at greater efficiency to ensure only the strongest survive.
STH_unicomplex_DESC: A Unicomplex is a vast Borg complex composed of thousands of connected structures and hubs spanning at least 600 square kilometres,as well as trillions of Borg Drones and hundreds of Borg Ships.
STH_unimatrix_finished_DESC: A habitable Section which gives millions of Borg space to operate.
STH_unimatrix_unfinished_DESC: At this location the Unicomplex can be expanded with another habitable section.
STH_voth_city_ship_0_DESC: The Voth City Ships are generational crafts housing multiple generations of the Voth.
STH_watchtower_station_DESC: A vital Starfleet Starbase, the Watchtower-Class Station offers an important diplomatic meeting point and reminder of the Federation's influence in the region.
argus_build_complete_DESC: A large array of subspace antennae clusters capable of collecting detailed information from many light years away.
argus_build_stage_DESC: The underlying substructure of antennae clusters that make up the array.
borg_transwarp_conduit_0_DESC: A transwarp conduit is an artificially-created energy conduit through the realm of subspace known as transwarp space. Accessed via tachyon pulses of alternating frequencies, the conduits are used to cover great distances in a short time.
daystrom_build_complete_DESC: Daystrom Station is a Federation space station that serves as a high-security black site of the Daystrom Institute.
daystrom_build_stage_DESC: The underlying substructure of the station that will contain the field emitters necessary for the creation of the Daystrom Station.
deep_space_station_build_stage_1_DESC: Lay the foundations for a new deep space station to defend our borders.
deep_space_station_upgrade_stage_1_DESC: Keeping our defences up to date is key to ensuring that our borders are secure. Upgrade a Deep Space Station to the latest design.
deep_space_station_upgrade_stage_2_DESC: Keeping our defences up to date is key to ensuring that our borders are secure. Upgrade a Deep Space Station to the latest design.
deep_space_station_upgrade_stage_3_DESC: Keeping our defences up to date is key to ensuring that our borders are secure. Upgrade a Deep Space Station to the latest design.
fluidic_rift_gateway_0_DESC: Exploiting weak points in the dimensional barrier between Fluidic Space and the normal realm to create a link between the two spaces.
fluidic_rift_gateway_1_DESC: The more advanced Fluidic Rift Generator allows for more controlled travel between realms.
fountain_build_complete_DESC: The Particle Fountain draws material straight from the planets surface directly into orbit, bypassing regular mining processes.
fountain_build_stage_DESC: The underlying substructure of the station that will contain the field emitters necessary for the creation of the particle fountain.
galactic_forum_1_DESC: A meeting place for galactic powers, increasing immigration attraction and global opinion of us.
galactic_forum_2_DESC: A meeting place for galactic powers, increasing immigration attraction and global opinion of us.
iconian_gateway_0_DESC: Massive ancient gateways of a long dead civilisation, capable of linking the most distant parts of the galaxy together.
midas_build_complete_DESC: This array will allow information to be communicated to fleets around the galaxy from many light years away, improving naval capacity.
midas_build_stage_DESC: The underlying substructure of antennae clusters that make up the array.
nor_space_station_build_stage_1_DESC: Central Command demands a show of power in this region, constructing a Nor Class facility will demonstrate that power.

Description: The ColAndor Scrolls are a revered Andorian artefact that has served as inspiration and guidance for the formation of governments. They were displayed as part of a cultural exhibition for the Tellarites, to demonstrate how they could establish their own government, but were stolen.
r_dilithium_incubator_desc:

Description: Written by Shoggoth, the novel covers numerous suspects, all being found guilty of similar crime with the mystery lying in the discovery of who exactly was guilty of what.

Description: The Torch of G'boj was lit in the fires of Mount Do'om and used to pierce the heart of Har'el the foul. Even now, the saying 'as bright as the Torch of G'boj' is still used to describe something dazzling.

Description: The Hand of Kull is a Klingon hand-held weapon, once wielded by the legendary warrior Kull. During the battle against Kinaan the Foul, Kull lost his left hand when slaying the tyrant.

r_horgahn_desc:

Category: £Carvings
Origin: £Risa£Epsilon Ceti£Alpha Quadrant
Description: A Horga'hn is a statuette that served as a fertility symbol on Risa. It is believed that to own one was to call forth its powers. Displaying one publicly indicates that one is seeking jamaharon, a mysterious and pleasurable practice native to that world.
r_kcabadge_desc:
Collection: £Heraldry

Origin: £Ba'ku£Briar Patch£Alpha Quadrant
Description: With the Ba'ku system under the control of the [Root.GetName], technology has been developed to harvest the metaphasic radiation within the rings, entailing the use of a piece of equipment known as an injector assembly to be launched from the Collector right into the rings of Ba'ku. There it will start a thermolytic reaction, the radiation of which to be collected by the collector.

Description: The great Cardassian work of literature, a masterpiece of repetitive epic spanning the trials of seven generations of the same family in service to the state.

Description: The Order of Basai is the name given to the master poets and storytellers amongst the Klingon people. Their passion and gift for telling tales of glory affords them great respect from fellow Klingons.
r_order_of_batleth_desc:
Collection: £Heraldry
Category: £Organizational Banners

Description: The Order of the Bat'leth is an exclusive Klingon group, a status awarded to warriors who had distinguished themselves in battle.

Description: The Ferengi Rules of Acquisition are a collection of two hundred and eighty-five sayings that form the basis of Ferengi philosophy.
r_sabaks_armour_desc:

Origin: £Qo'noS£Qo'noS£Beta Quadrant
Description: Sabak's armour is a highly revered artifact from the history of the Klingon civilization, based on the storied exploits of Sabak who held the pass of Gri'mash against a thousand enemies.
r_sacred_chalice_of_rixx_desc:

Description: The Sacred Chalice of Rixx lies in the hands of the Fifth House of Betazed. Whilst it is a prestigious artifact, the Fifth House knows that really it is just an old clay pot with mold growing inside it.

Category: £Psionic Weapons
Origin: £Vulcan£40 Eridani£Alpha Quadrant
Description: The Stone of Gol is an ancient weapon conceived on Vulcan during the turbulent times before the Time of Awakening. It functioned as a psionic resonator which focused and amplified telepathic energy, specifically any violent thoughts and emotions many hold and then turned them back upon the person experiencing them.

It became useless to the Vulcans long ago as they began to follow the teachings of Surak.
r_sword_of_kahless_desc:
Collection: £Weapons and Armor
Category: £Melee Weapons
Origin: £Qo'noS£Qo'noS£Beta Quadrant
Description: The first Bat'leth ever forged. It was designed and created by Kahless the Unforgettable and was dated to the 9th century AD. According to Klingon mythology, Kahless created the sword by dropping a lock of his hair into a river of lava from Kri'stak's summit, and then cooling the burning lock in the Lake of Lusor and forging it into a blade.
r_tantalus_device_desc:
Collection: £Weapons and Armor
Category: £Personal Devices
Origin: £Mirror Universe
Description: Controlling the mysterious Tantalus Field, this device has a handy side effect of making people just 'disappear'.
r_terran_badge_desc:
Collection: £Heraldry
Category: £Personal Insignia
Origin: £Mirror Universe
Description: This combadge is all that remains of the Terran invasion from a breach between dimensions.
r_terran_sword_desc:
Collection: £Weapons and Armor
Category: £Melee Weapons
Origin: £Mirror Universe £Terra£Sol£Alpha Quadrant
Description: The Terran Sword of State is part of the Regalia of some of the Terran Emperors, symbolising the power of the wielder to use the might of the state against its enemies.
r_time_crystal_bracelet_desc:
Collection: £Weapons and Armor
Category: £Personal Devices
Origin: £Harcourt Fenton Mudd
Description: This mysterious wrist worn device allows the wielder to cause a temporal loop for a short period of time, allowing endless possibilities.
r_tox_uthat_desc:
Collection: £Weapons and Armor
Category: £Weapons of Mass Destruction
Origin: Displaced £Risa£Epsilon Ceti£Alpha Quadrant
Description: The Tox Uthat is a quantum phase inhibitor, a device capable of halting all nuclear fusion within a star. Quantum dating of the artifact puts it's creation centuries from now.

Category: £Device Components

r_veridian_ship_crash: The crashed remains of a Hero Ship
r_veridian_ship_crash_desc:
Collection: £Starships
Category: £Historical Vessels

r_vger_probe_desc:

Category: £Monster Fragment

Description: The core of the Vger Probe turned out to be made from Voyager 6 thought lost forever. The databanks are a source of much potential research.

r_vulcan_trophy_desc:
Collection: £Starships
Category: £War Trophy
Origin: £Vulcan£Vulcan£Beta Quadrant
Description: A prize from our victory over the Vulcans.
r_whale_probe_desc:
Collection: £Space Debris
Category: £Monster Fragment
Origin: £Extragalactic
Description: This detachable sphere was part of the cylindrical 'whale probe' which was launched at us. Even now, it emits a steady source of energy.
r_yan_isleth_desc:
Collection: £Heraldry
Category: £Organizational Banners
Origin: £Qo'noS£Qo'noS£Beta Quadrant
Description: The Yan-Isleth, also known as the Brotherhood of the Sword, are elite Klingon warriors that serve as the personal security force for the Chancellor of the High Council of the Klingon Empire.
r_zefram_shotgun_desc:
Collection: £Weapons and Armor
Category: £Ranged Weapons
Origin: £Mirror Universe £Terra£Sol£Alpha Quadrant
Description: Zefram Cochrane used this very shotgun to kill the first Vulcan who set foot on the planet Earth in 2063, beginning the Terran Empire's advance across the Alpha and Beta Quadrants. It still holds a special place in every Terran's heart, as well as serving as a reminder of Terran rule to the alien species who have been subjugated by it.
sth_closure_gateway_0_DESC: Closing down these gateways that allow our enemies access deep into our territory is vital for the defense of our borders.
sth_hyper_relay_DESC: The planetary system space traffic control centre manages warp traffic into and out of the system providing faster and more efficient travel between aligned worlds.
underspace_corridor_0_DESC: The Underspace is a network of subspace corridors that extends through the galaxy, allowing starships to traverse vast distances in a short time.
watchtowner_build_stage_DESC: The underlying substructure of the station that once completed will form a Watchtower Class Station.
